title: Task Checklist for AI Agents: Turn Any Spec Into Tasks
description:
Big specs overwhelm your AI coding agent? Split them into a checklist. ✅

✅ Create TASKS.md with one checkbox per small task
✅ Make every task testable
✅ Count the open tasks with one grep command

Day 3 of Spec-Driven AI! Next up, Day 4: Make AI Plan Before It Codes.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

comment: Spec or checklist: which do you write first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: keep every task small enough for one test, so the agent's change stays easy to review.
